lectures.title: Lecture 8 - Product and Quotient Rules (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)
lectures.captions_srt:
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,500
Okay, today we look at derivatives of products.

2
00:00:04,500 --> 00:00:11,000
A common mistake is to say the derivative of f times g is f prime times g prime.

3
00:00:11,000 --> 00:00:19,000
That is wrong. The product rule says it is f prime times g plus f times g prime.

4
00:00:19,000 --> 00:00:30,000
Let us check it on x squared times sine x. We get two x sine x plus x squared cosine x.

5
00:01:00,000 --> 00:01:35,000
Next, the quotient rule: low d high minus high d low, over low squared.

lectures.title: Lecture 9 - Rates of Change (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)
lectures.captions_srt:
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:08,000
Velocity is the derivative of position with respect to time.

2
00:00:08,000 --> 00:00:16,000
Acceleration is the derivative of velocity, so the second derivative of position.

3
00:00:16,000 --> 00:00:40,000
If position is t cubed, velocity is three t squared and acceleration is six t.
